exercises.setup: Bench with back support, feet flat on the floor, dumbbells you can control for every rep.
exercises.source_name: Strength Level; We Are The Mighty
steps: Sit with your back against the pad and dumbbells at shoulder height, elbows slightly in front of and under your hands.
Brace your core.
Press up until arms are almost straight, without locking the elbows. Pause briefly.
Lower slowly until upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Breathe out as you press, in as you lower.

mistakes.fix: Lighter weight, ribs down, glutes and back on the pad.
Lower under control, pause for a beat.
Press both arms together; drop weight if they drift apart.

exercises.setup: Seated, light-to-moderate dumbbells. This is a rotation exercise, so go lighter than a normal press.
steps: Start with dumbbells at chest height, palms facing you.
Press up while smoothly rotating palms to face forward.
Finish just short of lockout.
Reverse the rotation as you lower back to the start.

mistakes.fix: Drop the weight until the rotation is smooth.
Rotate the whole forearm and elbow as one movement.
Slow tempo, exhale on the press.

exercises.setup: Light dumbbells. Heavy weight turns this into a swing.
steps: Stand tall, dumbbells at your sides, slight constant bend in the elbows.
Lead with the elbows and raise arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly, taking about as long as the lift.

mistakes.fix: Lighter weight, stay still from the hips up.
Keep shoulders down, think elbows out.

exercises.setup: Dumbbells or barbell at a weight you can lift without jerking.
steps: Stand tall with arms straight at your sides.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause at the top.
Lower to a full stretch.

mistakes.fix: Arms stay straight, the shoulders do the work.

exercises.setup: Cable pulleys set at chest-to-shoulder height. Light weight.
steps: Cross the handles (right hand takes the left cable) and stand back with a soft knee bend.
Pull the handles out and back in a wide T, leading with the elbows.
Squeeze shoulder blades together at the end.
Return slowly.

mistakes.fix: Light weight, feel the rear shoulder.

exercises.setup: Hands under or just outside the shoulders, on a flat floor.
steps: Make a straight line from head to heels, neck neutral.
Keep elbows about 45 degrees from the body.
Lower until your chest is nearly at the floor (elbows at least 90 degrees).
Press back up to straight arms.

mistakes.fix: Lower hips into the straight line.

mistakes.mistake: Head dropping / hands too far forward
mistakes.fix: Eyes slightly ahead, hands under shoulders.

steps.instruction: Easy cardio such as rowing, bike or brisk walk
Warm-up set of your first exercise with light weight
Breathe slowly; a mild pull is fine, pain is not
